ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: The Contagion
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
CONTAGION_RM_MOD_BUILD_1 (Phase A row 16 of design/RimMandrake/biome_mod_architecture.md; parent BIOME_MOD_SPLIT_EXECUTION_1). The Contagion, fully generalized: it names no other franchise or campaign and is playable standalone on any generated RimWorld planet. A separate frozen campaign world's own instance is unaffected; this is a new sibling biome for everyone else's worlds, not a rename of that one.
RM tier: nothing here knows what campaign or planet uses it.
A red valley on a scalded mountain, roofed by a thunderstorm that has never been known to stop: an open-throttle bioweapon mutation engine, running unchecked because it is the one place on the dayside where heat and water are both unlimited. Under the cloud everything is wet, warm and unfinished; when the cloud tears, the clear sky is the killer. Ships the biome (own worldgen placement worker, `RM_BiomeWorker_Contagion`, replacing the donor Alpha Biomes `BiomeWorker_OcularForest` — a donor type in `workerClass` is a hard dependency the RimMandrake tier may not assume), its full resident roster transplanted wholesale from the frozen campaign twin (11 `wildAnimals` rows, 10 `wildPlants` rows, Alpha Biomes' weather and Alpha Biomes/vanilla disease suite), and a Mod Settings screen with the standard worldgen-rarity master toggle (MOD_OPTIONS_RETROFIT_1 doctrine — default = shipped behavior, 0 = never generates).
`CONTAGION_GENOME_ORGAN_GROWING_1` (2026-09-26) added the mod's first real mechanic: a colonist can be operated on (`RM_ExtractGenomeSample`, a Medicine surgical bill) to draw a genome sample, then carry it to a live `AA_RedGoo` — the roster's own "the body" — and inject it (a right-click interaction, `RM_InjectGenomeSample`). The amoeba gestates for 4 in-game days (`RM_AmoebaGestation`), then dies producing 2-4 ordinary vanilla organs (kidney/liver/lung/heart) tagged with the source colonist's identity via a comp patched onto those four vanilla ThingDefs — the host is consumable, one batch per amoeba, per the owner's ruling. Gated by its own Mod Settings toggle, default on. The Burn/Bloom weather mechanic and the Unfinished's random-mutation spawner (`CONTAGION_UNFINISHED_SPAWNER_1` — referenced by name in earlier design prose but not a filed ledger item as of this build) remain unbuilt design work and land here later, at any point, with no dependency direction.
Zero Star Wars content lives in this biome's roster at all — the twin's own `wildAnimals` carries no `RSW_`/`SW_`/`mlie.*` row, so no Utinni patch is needed for fauna (unlike most sibling RM_ biome mods, there is no `WildAnimals_Contagion.xml`).
⚠️ One row is neither ours-standalone nor Star Wars: `RUT_Sytheclaw`, a RimMandrake-tier creature the frozen campaign shares inline across three biomes (Pyrelands, Greentide, here) whose ThingDef/PawnKindDef still live in the RimUtinni tier (`RUT_PyrelandsPortedFauna.xml`). Wiring it inline here would be a live cross-tier dependency (a franchise-free def needing a campaign-tier def to resolve), so it ships `MayRequire="mandrake.rut.patches"` — same caution `WildAnimals_Greentide.xml` already records for this same creature. It is one of 52 species `BIOME_SPECIFIC_FAUNA_LAW_1` lists as multi-homed and unadjudicated; multi-home evictions are stopped by owner ruling, so it is not moved or renamed here.
⚠️ Not entirely donor-free: all ten `wildPlants` rows and the terrain/texture fields carry no `MayRequire`, inherited unguarded from the frozen campaign twin (pre-existing gap, not introduced by this build). The eleven `wildAnimals` rows keep their original `MayRequire="sarg.alphaanimals"` gates (bar `RUT_Sytheclaw`, above) and degrade gracefully without it. `RUT_RustPuff` is a real cross-mod dependency on `mandrake.rut.rotsporekit`, kept as the twin had it, pending that kit's eventual absorption into `mandrake.rm.therot`.
NOT in this mod: the Ashfall Research Base and every other campaign plot hook (`OCULAR_OVERDRIVE_SITE_1`); F5, "the Contagion die-off ring," which is a mechanic of the neighboring Forge biome despite the name and already ships in `RimMandrake.EnvironmentalHazards` — its defs stay in RimUtinni pending `THEFORGE_RM_MOD_BUILD_1`, not this build.
Live proof (step 5, a scratch-world quicktest with all five expansions) is Desktop-only and OWED — see the item's own verify record.
